400.title: invalid cursor
400.detail: use the next_cursor from the previous response without modification

403.title: API key forbidden
403.detail: the API key lacks the required scope

404.title: unknown product

409.title: cursor expired

422.title: query window unavailable
422.detail: requested time range is outside the current publication's complete availability window

500.title: data query failed
500.detail: the current publication could not be queried

503.title: product not ready
503.detail: current publication availability evidence is not ready
